instruction.text: Complete the statements about the geography of Africa.

atoms.b: Africa is almost completely surrounded by ((++water land)).
North Africa is home to the world’s largest hot desert, the ((++Sahara Cairo)).
The largest city in Africa is ((++Cairo Nile)) in Egypt.
Near Cairo, one of the world’s longest rivers, the ((++Nile Atlantic)), flows into the Mediterranean Sea.
Africa has a population of around 1.5 billion people, with many of them living in large cities like ((++Lagos Cambodia)) and Cape Town.

instruction.text: Read the text about Africa’s landscapes.

atoms.text: Africa is the warmest of all continents and is made up of lots of different landscapes. Central Africa has very humid rainforests with dense vegetation.
atoms.sound: Africa is the warmest of all continents and is made up of lots of different landscapes. Central Africa has very humid rain forests with dense vegetation.

atoms.text: Almost no plants grow in the deserts of North Africa, while trees and shrubs only grow sporadically in the savannahs of the south.

hint.label: Savannahs
hint.text: A savannah is a flat, tropical grassy plain with scattered trees.

instruction.text: Complete the statements about the geography of Asia.

atoms.b: Asia is the ((++largest smallest)) of all the continents.
This huge continent borders ((++Europe North_America)) to the west, Africa to the south-west and Oceania to the ((++south-east north-east)).
In South Asia, you can find the ((++Himalayas Caucasus)), a mountain range including the highest mountain on Earth: ((++Mount river)) Everest.
Asia is also by far the most populated ((++continent country)) on the planet. Here you can find the ((++most least)) populated city worldwide: Jakarta in Indonesia.

instruction.text: Read the text about the climate zones of Asia.

text: There are five major climate zones on Earth: tropical, dry, temperate, continental and polar. Each zone makes up an area where temperatures and weather are fairly similar.
hint.label: Climate zones

atoms.text: Asia also has many different climate zones. Most people probably think of the tropical rainforests in the far south with a warm and humid climate.
atoms.sound: Asia also has many different climate zones. Most people probably think of the tropical rain-forests in the far south with a warm and humid climate.

atoms.text: However, there are also deserts in Central Asia and areas of tundra in the north, with cold temperatures and no trees.
